## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: narrow tech leadership (Top 5 all Technology) and major divergence across mega-caps (AAPL, INTC, GOOGL showing 1W vs 1M mismatch) — keep stance neutral and data-driven.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Technology leads: ORCL (1W: +20.62% | 1M: +27.76%) ABOVE TREND, IBM (1W: +19.76% | 1M: +34.16%) ABOVE TREND, NOW (1W: +15.45% | 1M: +28.19%) ABOVE TREND. Energy showing selective strength: VLO (1W: +8.78% | 1M: +4.40%) ABOVE TREND, XOM (1W: +3.13% | 1M: -0.08%) RECOVERY. Materials: FCX (1W: +11.02% | 1M: +27.12%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Communication weak: GOOGL (1W: -7.67% | 1M: -6.33%) BELOW TREND, CHTR (1W: -12.35% | 1M: -21.97%) BELOW TREND. Consumer Staples under pressure: CL (1W: -7.03% | 1M: -0.59%) BELOW TREND, EL (1W: -9.69% | 1M: +1.28%) CORRECTION. Financials soft: BLK (1W: -7.42% | 1M: -5.83%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: ORCL (1W: +20.62% | 1M: +27.76%) ABOVE TREND; IBM (1W: +19.76% | 1M: +34.16%) ABOVE TREND; NOW (1W: +15.45% | 1M: +28.19%) ABOVE TREND; AVGO (1W: +13.60% | 1M: +15.06%) ABOVE TREND; PANW (1W: +12.86% | 1M: +51.95%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (5/5 Technology).

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: CL (1W: -7.03% | 1M: -0.59%) BELOW TREND; BLK (1W: -7.42% | 1M: -5.83%) BELOW TREND; CEG (1W: -7.43% | 1M: -16.63%) BELOW TREND; INTC (1W: -7.44% | 1M: +17.68%) CORRECTION; GOOGL (1W: -7.67% | 1M: -6.33%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in Financials/Comm/Staples.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Biggest 1W movers: ORCL (1W: +20.62%), IBM (1W: +19.76%), NOW (1W: +15.45%), AVGO (1W: +13.60%), PANW (1W: +12.86%) — strong short-term momentum but watch narrow concentration. Major divergence present (AAPL, INTC, GOOGL etc.), signaling tactical risk.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Mixed: strong small-/mid-cap tech leadership while several mega-caps show fatigue. NVDA (1W: +1.01% | 1M: +8.20%) ABOVE TREND; MSFT (1W: +3.55% | 1M: +3.54%) ABOVE TREND; AAPL (1W: -0.19% | 1M: +12.18%) CORRECTION — sector up 1W but leadership narrow, monitor for follow-through.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Soft overall with selective recovery signals. JPM (1W: +0.52% | 1M: -2.21%) RECOVERY, but BLK (1W: -7.42% | 1M: -5.83%) BELOW TREND and CME (1W: -9.48% | 1M: -12.97%) BELOW TREND — breadth within Financials is weak.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Mixed/patchy: defensive names showing exhaustion while biotech catalysts appear. LLY (1W: -0.38% | 1M: +11.64%) CORRECTION, JNJ (1W: -3.48% | 1M: +0.14%) CORRECTION, PFE (1W: -3.32% | 1M: -2.06%) BELOW TREND — watch headline-driven moves.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor selective technology leaders showing ABOVE TREND (ORCL, IBM, NOW) and cyclical Energy/Materials exposure (VLO, FCX) while reducing exposure to weak Communication and Consumer Staples names. Style: mixed / no clear leadership given narrow tech concentration and broad mega-cap divergence; monitor AAPL/GOOGL/INTC for confirmation before adding broad risk.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: ORCL (1W: +20.62% | 1M: +27.76%) ABOVE TREND, IBM (1W: +19.76% | 1M: +34.16%) ABOVE TREND, AVGO (1W: +13.60% | 1M: +15.06%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: GOOGL (1W: -7.67% | 1M: -6.33%) BELOW TREND, AMZN (1W: -8.03% | 1M: -8.10%) BELOW TREND, CHTR (1W: -12.35% | 1M: -21.97%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Technology, Energy, Materials (these three are the only positive sectors this week). BEARISH: Communication, Consumer Staples, Financials — monitor for continued outflows.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
Watch ORCL for follow-through above this week’s breakout (extends ABOVE TREND momentum); NVDA hold of its 1M uptrend is a trigger for tech breadth recovery; GOOGL break below this week’s lows would confirm BELOW TREND continuation; JPM sustaining RECOVERY gains would help Financials stabilize.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
LLY (+60): headline on Retevmo growth; LLY (1W: -0.38% | 1M: +11.64%) CORRECTION — bullish news but short-term pullback, watch for follow-through. INTC (+50): Foxconn/Intel AI tie-up; INTC (1W: -7.44% | 1M: +17.68%) CORRECTION — positive catalyst but price falling = divergence. MA (+55): stablecoin platform headlines; MA (1W: -4.75% | 1M: -6.58%) BELOW TREND — positive news countered by weak price action, monitor.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
AVGO (-65): negative outlook headlines but AVGO (1W: +13.60% | 1M: +15.06%) ABOVE TREND — clear divergence (negative sentiment vs price strength). GOOGL (-45): capital raise headlines; GOOGL (1W: -7.67% | 1M: -6.33%) BELOW TREND — sentiment and price confirm weakness. UNH (-50): Medicare reimbursement concerns; UNH (1W: -1.83% | 1M: +1.69%) CORRECTION — bearish news aligning with short-term softness.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership. ORCL (1W: +20.62% | 1M: +27.76%) ABOVE TREND, IBM (1W: +19.76% | 1M: +34.16%) ABOVE TREND and NOW (1W: +15.45% | 1M: +28.19%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk is major divergence among mega-caps (AAPL, INTC, GOOGL) and headline-driven mismatches (AVGO negative sentiment vs rising price) — monitor for confirmation.
